steps.title: Compose
steps.body: Write MDX and JSON. Keep trim, color, and margins out of the copy.

steps.title: Preview
steps.body: Read the sheets in the browser. Expect a fast refresh, not final folios.

steps.title: Paginate
steps.body: Run the PDF command. Check breaks, headings, figures, and events there.

steps.title: Hand off
steps.body: Send the digital file to readers. Treat the print layout as a proof until a press standard is actually produced.
